summary: Prepare opt-in custom footer gesture candidate for verification (unreleased WIP).

changes.title: Add an explicit custom gesture enrollment candidate
changes.detail: Introduce a default-off private footer drawing area, encrypted gesture and secret mapping, and guarded private-screen interactions. This work remains experimental and should not be released or used to replace strong biometric access without separate physical-device and security acceptance.

changes.title: Repair candidate compile errors and add trace safety tests
changes.detail: Use Float zero-fill for gesture templates, restore the protected-screen vault import, and test malformed, straight-line, matching, and nonmatching gesture traces. This candidate does not alter the production release or model packaging.
